name: Microsoft Agent Framework
summary: Framework for building, orchestrating and deploying AI agents and multi-agent workflows in Python and .NET; successor to AutoGen.
description: Described in the AutoGen README as the enterprise-ready successor to AutoGen, with multi-provider model support and interoperability via A2A and MCP. On 2026-11-21, https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework returned HTTP 404. Official docs at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/agent-framework/ (HTTP 200; the no-trailing-slash URL 301s there) and the Agent-Framework-Samples README still name that GitHub URL; no replacement repo is claimed here.
